answer_1.quote: We introduce PunchBench, a benchmark designed to evaluate the ability of MLLMs to comprehend multimodal punchlines.
answer_1.outputs: reasoning sentences explaining punchlines in image-caption pairs

answer_2.quote: For Generation QA, where the responses from MLLMs are free-form, we resort to gpt-3.5-turbo-0125 to assess whether the response matches the semantics of the annotated reasoning sentence with a binary judgment "Yes" or "No".

answer_4.quote: To validate the reliability of automatic evaluation for Generation QA, we conduct human evaluation through pairwise test. Specifically, we first randomly sample 100 pairs of reasoning sentences from two candidate models. And we then involve three independent annotators (undergraduate students uninvolved in this work) to compare reasoning sentences generated by two models (A and B) for the same image-caption pair.
answer_4.guideline: The annotators are supposed to choose one of three options: i.e., "A Wins", "A Draws B" and "B Wins".
